fun_fact: Oct 2–8 is Wildlife Week in India. India is home to about 75% of the world's wild tigers, and Gir is the last wild home of the Asiatic lion. But wildlife is much more than tigers and lions and protecting them will need more than just creating a few tiger reserves. We'll explore a few of these topics over the next 1 week. Keep solving Torchlight!
author: Sailee
